questions.question: You meet a school friend after a year. What is the most natural thing to say?
questions.explanation: Jaan-pehchaan wale se dobara milne par 'Nice to see you again' kehte hain. 'Nice to meet you' sirf pehli mulaqat ke liye hai, 'Good night' vidaai ke waqt bola jaata hai (greeting ke liye nahi), aur 'Myself Rohan' standard English nahi hai.

questions.question: You enter a formal interview room at 10 a.m. Which greeting is most appropriate?
questions.explanation: Setting formal hai aur subah ka time hai, isliye 'Good morning.' 'Hey, what's up?' aur 'Yo, guys!' bahut informal hain, aur 'Good night' vidaai ka phrase hai, greeting nahi.

questions.question: A new classmate asks, 'How are you?' Which reply is the most appropriate?
options: I'm fine, thanks. How about you?
questions.explanation: 'I'm fine, thanks. How about you?' polite hai aur sawaal wapas pooch kar baat-cheet aage badhata hai. 'Why do you ask?' rude lagta hai, salary ek sensitive topic hai, aur 'Fine. Bye.' baat ko turant khatam kar deta hai.

questions.question: Which sentence is best for a formal self-introduction?
options: I passed out from Delhi University in 2023.
I am passed out from Delhi University.
I have passed out from Delhi University in 2023.
I graduated from Delhi University in 2023.
questions.explanation: Standard English mein degree poori karne ko 'graduated from' kehte hain. 'pass out' ka standard meaning behosh ho jaana hai, isliye baaki teeno options Indianism hain (aur option 3 mein '2023' jaise specific past time ke saath present perfect bhi galat hai).

questions.question: Which question should you AVOID asking someone you have just met?
options: How was your trip to Ooty?
questions.explanation: Salary (income) ek personal aur sensitive topic hai, jo pehli mulaqat mein avoid karna chahiye. Course, hobbies (cricket) aur travel safe small-talk topics hain.

questions.question: Arrange these lines into the best self-introduction.
questions.code:
P: I'm currently in the first year of the BS Data Science programme.
Q: Good morning, everyone.
R: Thank you, and I look forward to learning with all of you.
S: I'm Neha, and I'm from Indore.
questions.explanation: Self-introduction ka structure: greeting (Q), naam aur background (S), abhi kya kar rahe ho (P), phir polite closing (R). Isliye Q S P R. 'SQPR' greeting se pehle naam bol deta hai, 'QPSR' naam se pehle course batata hai, aur 'QSRP' closing ke baad nayi information deta hai.

questions.question: How many of these lines from a self-introduction need to be corrected?
questions.code:
(1) Myself Sana.
(2) I'm from Jaipur.
(3) I am knowing Excel well.
(4) I graduated from college in 2024.
questions.explanation: (1) galat hai: 'Myself Sana' ki jagah 'I'm Sana'. (3) galat hai: 'know' stative verb hai, toh 'I know Excel well'. (2) aur (4) bilkul sahi hain. Isliye 2 lines theek karni hongi. Trap: 'I graduated from college' ko 'passed out' jaisa samajh kar galat gin lena.

questions.question: A new classmate says, 'I spent the weekend at a hackathon.' Which reply is an open follow-up question that best keeps the conversation going?
options: Oh, interesting! What did your team build?
questions.explanation: 'What did your team build?' open question hai: iska jawab sirf haan ya naa mein nahi diya ja sakta, isliye saamne wala detail mein bolega. 'Did you go alone?' aur 'Was it on Saturday?' closed (yes/no) questions hain jo ek word ke jawab par ruk jaate hain, aur 'Okay.' baat khatam kar deta hai.

questions.question: A professor you met last month at a workshop says, 'Good to see you again, Rahul.' Which reply is most appropriate?
options: Good to see you too, Professor.
questions.explanation: Aap professor se pehle mil chuke ho aur setting formal hai, isliye 'Good to see you too, Professor.' Trap: 'Nice to meet you' sirf pehli mulaqat ke liye hota hai. 'Yo, what's up?' professor ke liye bahut casual hai, aur 'Myself Rahul' Indianism hai.

weeks.title: Paragraphs and Emails
weeks.summary: Achha writing clear structure se aata hai. Is week aap topic sentence wala paragraph likhna, linkers use karna aur ek formal email ka sahi format seekhoge.
concepts: **Paragraph structure**: Topic sentence (main idea) + supporting sentences (reasons, examples) + concluding sentence (summary ya final thought).
**Unity**: Ek paragraph mein sirf ek main idea. Jo sentence topic se related nahi, use hata do.
**Coherence with linkers**: Ideas ko jodne ke liye: firstly, moreover (addition), however (contrast), therefore (result), for example, finally.
**Formal email parts**: Clear subject line, salutation (Dear Professor Iyer,), opening line mein purpose, short body, clear request, closing (Regards / Yours sincerely), aur poora naam.
**Subject line**: Specific aur short: 'Request for extension of Week 4 assignment deadline'. 'Hi' ya 'Urgent!!!' jaise vague subjects avoid karo.
**Formal tone**: 'Hey', 'plz', 'u', emojis aur ALL CAPS formal email mein nahi. Polite phrases: 'I would be grateful if...', 'Could you please...'.
**Revise before sending**: Spelling, grammar, attachments aur recipient ka naam ek baar check karo.

example.problem: Is informal message ko formal email mein badlo: 'hey sir plz extend deadline, was sick. thx'
steps: Subject line likho: 'Request for extension of assignment deadline due to illness'.
Salutation: 'Dear Sir,' (ya naam pata ho toh 'Dear Professor Rao,').
Opening mein purpose: 'I am writing to request a short extension for the Week 6 assignment.'
Reason politely: 'I was unwell for the past three days and could not complete it on time.'
Clear request: 'I would be grateful if you could allow me to submit it by Friday.'
Closing: 'Thank you for your understanding. Regards,' phir poora naam.
Answer: Ek structured email jismein subject, salutation, purpose, reason, request aur polite closing ho, bina 'hey', 'plz', 'thx' ke.

mistakes: Email mein subject line khaali chhodna ya 'Hi' likhna. Subject se hi reader ko pata chalna chahiye ki email kis baare mein hai.
Paragraph mein unrelated baatein daal dena. Har sentence ke baare mein poocho: kya yeh topic sentence ko support karta hai?
revision: Paragraph = topic sentence + support + conclusion.
Ek paragraph, ek idea (unity).
Linkers: moreover, however, therefore, for example.
Email: subject, salutation, purpose, body, request, closing, naam.
Formal email mein 'hey', 'plz', emojis nahi.

questions.question: Which is the best subject line for an email asking for more time to submit an assignment?
options: Request for extension of Week 4 assignment deadline
questions.explanation: Achha subject line specific hota hai aur reader ko bina email khole purpose bata deta hai. 'Hi', 'Urgent!!!' aur 'please read this' vague hain aur unprofessional lagte hain.

questions.question: Which is the most appropriate salutation for an email to a professor whose name you know?
questions.explanation: Formal email mein 'Dear' + title + surname standard hai: 'Dear Professor Iyer,'. Baaki teeno bahut casual hain aur professor ke liye respectful nahi lagte.

questions.question: Which sentence works best as the topic sentence of a paragraph on the benefits of online learning?
options: I logged in at 7 p.m. yesterday.
Some lecture videos are twenty minutes long.
Online learning gives students flexibility in where and when they study.
In conclusion, that is all I have to say.
questions.explanation: Topic sentence paragraph ka main idea batata hai, aur option 3 seedha 'benefit' (flexibility) introduce karta hai. Options 1 aur 2 chhoti details hain, aur option 4 conclusion jaisa hai, opening nahi.

questions.question: I wanted to avoid last-minute stress. ___, I started the assignment a week early.
questions.explanation: Doosra sentence pehle sentence ka result hai (stress avoid karna tha, isliye jaldi shuru kiya), isliye 'Therefore'. 'However' contrast dikhata hai, aur 'Although' / 'Despite' sentence ke shuru mein is tarah comma ke saath akele nahi lagte.

questions.question: Which closing is most suitable for a formal email to a course instructor?
questions.explanation: 'Regards' ke saath poora naam ek safe, professional closing hai. 'Love' personal hai, 'Bye bye!' bolchaal wala hai, aur 'TTYL' chat ki short form hai jo formal email mein nahi chalti.

questions.question: A paragraph argues that students should sleep 7 to 8 hours before an exam. Which sentence does NOT belong in it?
options: Sleep helps the brain store what we studied during the day.
Many hostels serve breakfast at 7:30 a.m.
A tired mind makes more careless mistakes in calculations.
Students who rest well usually concentrate better in the exam hall.
questions.explanation: Hostel ke breakfast time ka neend aur exam performance se koi relation nahi hai, isliye yeh paragraph ki unity todta hai. Baaki teeno sentences seedhe 'neend kyun zaroori hai' ko support karte hain.

questions.question: Which linker shows ADDITION (adding one more point)?
questions.explanation: 'Moreover' ek aur point jodne ke liye use hota hai (addition). 'However' contrast dikhata hai, 'Therefore' result, aur 'Although' bhi contrast wala dependent clause shuru karta hai.

questions.question: In a well-written paragraph, which sentence states the main idea?
questions.explanation: Topic sentence paragraph ka main idea batata hai; supporting aur example sentences us idea ko support karte hain. Subject line email ka hissa hai, paragraph ka nahi.

questions.question: Which phrase is suitable for a formal email?
options: I would be grateful if you could
questions.explanation: 'I would be grateful if you could...' ek polite, formal phrase hai. 'plz', 'asap' aur 'u' chat ki short forms hain, aur ALL CAPS chillane jaisa lagta hai, isliye yeh formal email mein nahi chalte.

questions.question: In a formal email, what should come right after the salutation (for example, 'Dear Professor Iyer,')?
options: An opening line that states the purpose
questions.explanation: Salutation ke turant baad opening line mein email ka purpose batana chahiye, taaki reader ko shuru mein hi pata chale ki email kis baare mein hai. Closing aur poora naam email ke end mein aate hain, aur subject line salutation se pehle (email ke upar) hoti hai.

questions.question: Which is the best concluding sentence for a paragraph on why students should follow a regular study timetable?
options: Therefore, a fixed timetable helps students learn steadily and avoid stress.
My friend usually studies late at night after dinner.
First, make a list of all the subjects you need to study.
However, some subjects are much harder than the others.
questions.explanation: Concluding sentence main idea ko summarise karta hai, aur option 1 'Therefore' ke saath timetable ke fayde ko wrap up karta hai. Option 2 unrelated detail hai, option 3 instructions ki shuruaat jaisa hai, aur option 4 ek naya contrast khol deta hai, conclusion nahi deta.

questions.question: Choose the linkers for both blanks: 'Online classes save travel time. ___, they let students replay lectures. ___, some students find it hard to stay focused at home.'
questions.explanation: Pehla blank: lectures replay karna online classes ka ek aur fayda hai, toh addition: 'Moreover'. Doosra blank: ghar par focus na kar paana ek problem hai, jo faydon ke ulta hai, toh contrast: 'However'. Option 1 dono ko ulta rakhta hai, aur 'Therefore' galat hai kyunki replay karna travel time bachne ka result nahi hai.

questions.question: What is the main weakness of this email?
questions.code:
Subject: Hi

Dear Professor Menon,

I am writing to request an extension for the Week 9 assignment. I was unwell for four days and could not complete it on time. I would be grateful if you could allow me to submit it by Monday.

Regards,
Ishita Rao
questions.explanation: Salutation ('Dear Professor Menon,'), opening line mein purpose, polite request aur closing ('Regards' + poora naam) sab sahi hain. Sirf subject line 'Hi' vague hai; woh kuch aisi honi chahiye: 'Request for extension of Week 9 assignment deadline'.

questions.question: Which option correctly names the roles of sentence (1) and sentence (4)?
questions.code:
(1) Cycling to college has many benefits.
(2) It keeps students physically fit.
(3) It also saves money spent on fuel or auto fares.
(4) Clearly, cycling is a smart choice for students.
questions.explanation: Sentence (1) poore paragraph ka main idea (cycling ke fayde) batata hai, isliye topic sentence. Sentences (2) aur (3) fayde dete hain (supporting). Sentence (4) 'Clearly' ke saath idea ko wrap up karta hai, isliye concluding sentence. Trap: (4) bhi general hai, par woh shuru mein idea introduce nahi karta, end mein summary deta hai.

questions.question: Arrange these parts of a formal email in the correct order.
questions.code:
P: Regards, Aman Gupta
Q: Dear Professor Rao,
R: I am writing to ask about the date of the Week 10 quiz.
S: Could you please confirm whether it will be held on Friday?
questions.explanation: Formal email ka order: salutation (Q), opening line mein purpose (R), clear request (S), aur end mein closing + naam (P). Isliye Q R S P. 'QSRP' request ko purpose se pehle rakh deta hai, 'RQSP' salutation se pehle likhna shuru kar deta hai, aur 'QRPS' closing ke baad request daal deta hai.
